title_as_printed: Apolipoprotein E allele 4 effects on Single-Subject Gray Matter Networks in Mild Cognitive Impairment

blind_codes.Task_Type: T4 (T2 arguable: converter vs non-converter design, but group comparison only)
blind_codes.Sample_N: 200 MCI (100 converters + 100 non-converters; 50 ApoE4+ / 50 ApoE4- in each)

registry_codes.Sample_N_Approx: 200 — 100 MCI non-converters / 100 MCI converters; each split 50 ApoE4 carriers / 50 non-carriers

Task_Type.reason: ANCOVA of single-subject grey-matter network measures on ApoE4 status and future conversion, plus partial correlations with cognition and CSF. No classifier is fitted and no discrimination figure is reported; the paper itself lists classification as future work. The converter/non-converter design makes T2 conceivable, but the study compares groups rather than predicting.

Category.reason: The registry's C1 captures the primary domain (structural MRI grey-matter networks). ApoE4 genotype, the main grouping factor, and CSF Abeta42, T-tau and P-tau, analysed by ANCOVA and correlation, are C3 data. MMSE and ADNI-MEM (C5) are analysed as well. These secondary domains are omitted.
Category.quote: We also explored the correlation of SSGMNets attributes with general cognition score (MMSE), memory (ADNI-MEM), and CSF-derived biomarkers of AD (Aβ42, T-tau, and P-tau).

Validation_Type.reason: No predictive model. The KKI dataset is used only for test-retest reliability (ICC) of the network measures, not for model validation. Convention: V2.

Sample_N_Approx.reason: 100 non-converters + 100 converters, each split 50 ApoE4 carriers / 50 non-carriers. The CSF analyses used a smaller subset (ANCOVA df 118).
Sample_N_Approx.quote: we selected a sample of 200 late MCI participants subdivided into 100 late MCI non-converters and 100 converters to AD (Table 1). Each subgroup was subdivided into 50 Carriers (ApoE4 + ) and 50 non-Carriers’ (ApoE4-) patients.

ADNI_Dependent.reason: All 200 participants come from ADNI; KKI appears only in the reliability check.
ADNI_Dependent.quote: Our data sample comprised 200 MCI patients selected from the ADNI database
